confidence_notes: The FX rate is the latest RBA figure found by search (18 Nov 2026). Food and drink prices rest on thin search results: an undated Siargao menu listing beer at about 90-120 PHP and cocktails at about 180 PHP, a 2019 blog with meals at about 95-500 PHP, and one coffee price of 'from 100 pesos'. I found no cost-of-living index for Siargao. Wine is estimated from the beer relationship, since it is mostly imported and costly. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. Peak-season and surf-tourism pricing add further uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tourist-area prices in the Philippines, such as El Nido and Boracay, adjusted for Siargao's surf-resort pricing. Prices are above those in typical Philippine provincial towns.
